---

### ✅ Recurrence Relation

$$
\text{term}(n) = 
\begin{cases}
10, & \text{if } n = 0 \\
20, & \text{if } n > 0 \text{ and } n \mod 10 = 0 \\
\text{term}(n \mod 10), & \text{otherwise}
\end{cases}
$$

---

- **Base case 1**: `term(0) = 10` — this is explicitly given.
- **Base case 2**: For any `n > 0` that is a multiple of 10 (i.e., `n mod 10 == 0`), the value is **20**.
- **Recursive case**: For all other `n`, the value is determined by the value at `n mod 10`, which ensures the periodic behavior.
